rationale: C25 is a highly persuasive drafting template. The child reproduces its distinctive two-part delegation structure: first, a department secretary is designated and empowered to perform enumerated presidential functions without further presidential action; second, the secretary receives enumerated functions that previously required presidential approval. It also repeats nearly verbatim C25's definitions of “functions” and “perform” and its savings clause preserving prior presidential actions. C12 and C07 contain related delegation and continuity machinery, but neither matches the child's overall architecture as closely as C25.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby designated and empowered to perform the following-described functions of the President without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior is hereby designated and empowered to perform the following-described functions of the President without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim opening delegation formula, with only the department changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury is hereby designated and empowered to perform without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President the following functions which have heretofore, under the respective provisions of law cited, required the approval of the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior is hereby designated and empowered to perform, without the approval, ratification, or other action of the President, the following functions which have heretofore, under the respective provisions of law cited, required the approval, ratification, or other action of the President
shared_material.explanation: The child closely follows C25's distinctive second-stage delegation of functions formerly requiring presidential approval.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As used in this order, the term "functions" embraces duties, powers, responsibilities, authority, or discretion, and the term "perform" may be construed to mean "exercise".
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As used in this order, the term "functions" embraces duties, powers, responsibilities, authority, or discretion, and the term "perform" may be construed to mean "exercise".

shared_material.child_excerpt: All actions heretofore taken by the President in respect of the matters affected by this order and in force at the time of the issuance of this order, including regulations prescribed by the President in respect of such matters, shall, except as they may be inconsistent with the provisions of this order, remain in effect until amended, modified, or revoked pursuant to the authority conferred by this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All actions heretofore taken by the President in respect of the matters affected by this order and in force at the time of the issuance of this order, including regulations prescribed by the President in respect of such matters, shall, except as they may be inconsistent with the provisions of this order, remain in effect until modified or revoked pursuant to the authority conferred by this order.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical concluding savings clause preserving existing presidential actions and regulations.
